HEATHEN-ONLY EVENTS (HE-01 to HE-45, draft for the owner, 2026-11-23, target v1.35.98)
New Believers only. Island events about the Heathens' own lives: honoring their dead, Heathen versions of events our villagers already have, and small moments of camp life.

collection.description: The whole encampment gathers at the mud hut at dusk to remember the people the camp has lost.

setup.name: The scene
setup.text:
The whole encampment gathers at the mud hut at dusk. (subject), the eldest of those well enough to stand, says a few words about the people the camp has lost. They are not long words. Then everyone goes, one at a time, to touch the memorial post, and there is a meal afterwards, and the children are allowed to stay up late.
The Heathens' village shares a feast. \(no effect\)

effects.action: Honoring the dead or reflecting (at the encampment)

text_only.reason: the owner's flavor rule (2026-11-23): only Heathens are in this event, so the Heathens' village's food is story text only -- the game is not changed, and the draft's line ends "(no effect)"
